separation_rule.framework: Generic mechanics, schemas, registries and defaults.
separation_rule.project: Project configuration, derived theme overrides, template selection and extensions.
separation_rule.source: Business/source datasets, editorial content and reference inputs.
separation_rule.runtime: Generated browser-consumable artifacts and private runtime overlays that are not canonical.
separation_rule.providers: External-service and persistence adapters isolated from generic models.
separation_rule.generated: Non-canonical outputs regenerated from canonical sources.

rules: Release history belongs outside the active framework tree.
Global framework version belongs only to framework-manifest.json.
Canonical registry paths are resolved through the manifest rather than repeated here.
Missing physical layers may be created lazily when first used.
Private personal-storage data never belongs in generated public site output.
Persistence adapters reuse existing data/component contracts rather than creating alternate page implementations.

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Structure courante; persistance locale et stockage personnel sont des capacités optionnelles, pas de nouvelles racines métier.
